scope.inventory: Every public non-abstract C# class transitively deriving from ChartBase in the core Charts project. Controls and aliases are separate rows; series and configuration objects are not counted as independent controls.
scope.officialMapping: Intended feature-family IDs from docs/charts-official-alignment.md. These links do not claim equal public API, defaults, numerical behavior, performance or native-platform qualification.
scope.sourceAnchors: Each anchor is an exact trimmed source line; lineAtCatalogUpdate is informational and may shift. Direct means the concrete type is referenced, not that the reference was executed.
scope.packageConsumer: Shared Usage source is copied by scripts/Test-ChartsPackageConsumer.ps1 and called by its independent driver. Actual package/hash/cache/runtime evidence remains in each milestone validation report.
scope.sharedCapabilities: C7 integration tests and platform runs must separately establish shared theme, template, interaction, export and lifetime behavior. This catalog does not infer these from a control appearing in a family sample.
